name: Riptide-GP-vita
description: Android to PS Vita port of Riptide GP
long_description: This is a so-loader port. It runs the original `libBlue.so`, `libfmodex.so` and `libfmodevent.so` with an emulated Java layer (FalsoJNI). The game's own assets are read in place from `assets/Base.apf`, and the OpenGL ES 2.0 calls are served by vitaGL. Nothing from the game is distributed here; you need your own copy of the APK.
